findings.text: non-blocking: review_scores filters a plan-selected read on record.get("plan") and is reachable with plan= from reckon/mcp_views.py:4931, so a second plan-selected read still drops every brief-carried row; the landing line's "one owner" claim and the manifest's outside_scope inventory, which names :4449 and :4620 but not this site, are both incomplete.

non-blocking: the index version bump is the only thing that re-extracts already-stored rows, and no test covers it — reverting it to the previous value keeps all four new tests green because each reads a cold index over a fresh temporary store, so the "records already in the store" half of the goal is guarded by the one-off live pass alone.
